<p class="source-citation"><a href="https://docs.ogc.org/is/18-062r2/18-062r2.html#toc52">Published source: OGC 18-062r2, 1.0.0 (toc52)</a>.</p>

<div id="Callbacks">
<span id="toc52"></span>
<p id="_b9f897db-6cb6-fdf5-b4a5-3fa68272d1e3">The Callback conformance class specifies a callback mechanism for completed jobs. In contrast to the pull-based mechanism specified in <a href="#sc_create_job">Clause 7.11</a> and <a href="#sc_retrieve_status_info">Clause 7.12</a>, this conformance class specifies a push-based mechanism, where a subscriber-URL is passed to the API in the execute request. After the job is completed, the result response is sent to the specified URL.</p>
<span id="rc_callback"></span><!-- requirements-class -->
<span id="req_callback_job-callback"></span><!-- requirement: callback/job-callback -->
<p class="SourceTitle" style="text-align:center;">Example  — A callback in the execute operation</p>
<div class="example" id="_79963e27-d426-0ea5-1fca-4e0853e8e4fb"><pre class="prettyprint" id="_abb7136e-ce3e-24a4-79a1-04bbe91f9ac3">callbacks:<br/>    jobCompleted:<br/>      '{$request.body#/subscriber/successUri}':<br/>        post:<br/>          requestBody:<br/>            content:<br/>              application/json:<br/>                schema:<br/>                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/results'<br/>          responses:<br/>            '202':<br/>              description: Results received successfully</pre>
</div>
<p id="_fb46f12b-0ff2-15dd-e1c2-3646826d8396">If the server implements this conformance class, the optional subscriber element of the execute request JSON SHALL be used.</p>
<p id="_b2053bba-eec0-1ba0-ff6a-c1493af4093e">Adding multiple callbacks is possible for getting progress updates and notifications of the success or failure of a job completion.</p>
<p id="_a177cd5b-103b-c600-48e3-eefde1915baa">Further guidance about how to use callbacks can be found in the <a href="https://swagger.io/docs/specification/callbacks/">OpenAPI documentation</a>.</p>
</div>
